criteria.description: A database migration creates adopted_runtime_identity with unique persisted fingerprints for adopted workloads.
Docker discovery surfaces endpoint identity input and adoption stores image digest in adopted runtime config.
Adoption import resolves org_id from explicit input, a single existing environment org, or exactly one organization; ambiguous ownership fails closed.
Existing unresolved org ownership rows are marked for operator repair by migration instead of being silently assigned.
Persistent adoption identities are written atomically with service/environment import and used for subsequent service matching.
